purpose: Sorted multi-branch public case-fruit expansion plan for HK criminal law/procedure GraphRAG.

branch_allocations.notebooklm_prompt_hint: HK criminal investigation, arrest, search, detention and reasonable suspicion; include statutory powers, admissibility consequences and leading HK cases.
HK theft, fraud and dishonesty tests; include Theft Ordinance, Ghosh/Ivey treatment, HK CFA/CA lineages and offence-element cases.
HK unlawful assembly and riot lineage after Tong Wai Hung; include physical presence, joint enterprise/accessory liability, common purpose, peaceful assembly and overcharging.
HK criminal trial procedure, no-case submissions, jury directions, burden/standard and appellate treatment.
HK criminal appeals/reviews; include conviction/sentence appeal tests, proviso, unsafe conviction, questions of law and SJ references.
HK offences against the person; include homicide, assault, wounding/GBH, sexual offences, mens rea and sentencing/proof distinctions.
HK POBO, misconduct in public office and corruption lineages; include CFA/CA authorities and element-by-element treatment.
HK money laundering / OSCO s25 lineages; include reasonable grounds, knowledge, wilful blindness and statutory defence cases.
HK indictments and charge sheets; include drafting, amendment, joinder, severance and quashing authorities.
HK general criminal defences; include self-defence, duress, mistake, insanity, automatism and intoxication authorities.
HK NSL criminal procedure excluding bail; include search/seizure, designated judges, no jury, overseas lawyers and surveillance authorities.
Propose a HK case lineage and issue tree for Complainants in Specified Sexual Offences.
Propose a HK case lineage and issue tree for Actus Reus.

next_actions: For each priority-1 branch, collect 3-5 public landmark cases first.
Verify each candidate case against LegalRef/HKLII/Judiciary before extracting propositions.
Use DeepSeek only on one public paragraph at a time to propose candidate extraction rules.
Reject any proposal whose exact_quote is not a substring of the paragraph card.
Upsert only paragraph/proposition cards that passed source, quote, doctrine-node, and tenant checks.
Run retrieval benchmark after each 50-case branch rung; do not call the branch answer-safe until review/golden queries pass.
